privacy.gateBody: To follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, we need your consent before you continue. In short:

privacy.gatePoint1: We keep only what the app needs: your account, your practice and the reminders you choose.

privacy.gatePoint3: You can download your data, name a nominee, or delete your account at any time in My Profile.

privacy.panelSub: Your choices under India's data protection law
privacy.permBootBody: so your reminders keep working after your phone restarts.
privacy.permLocationBody: only while the app is open and only when you tap My Location. You can refuse and choose a region instead.
privacy.permMediaBody: asked only when you save a wallpaper, or when an administrator uploads a deity image or chant audio. We never scan your photo library or record without you starting it.
privacy.permNotificationsBody: for the reminders and alerts you choose. Turn each type off in the app, or all of them in your phone settings.

privacy.rightEraseBody: delete your account in My Profile. Your account, practice, favourites, notifications, devices, feedback and consent history are erased at once. Security logs are kept until their one-year period ends, because the law requires it.
privacy.rightGrievanceBody: write to us (section 12 below) or send Feedback with the type Privacy / My Data Request. We reply within 30 days.
privacy.rightNominateBody: name a person in My Profile who may use these rights for you if you die or become unable to.
privacy.rowAccountData: Full name, email, mobile number, seeker name (optional), preferred region (optional)
privacy.rowAccountPurpose: To create your account, sign you in, greet you by name and show the deities and chants of your region.
privacy.rowDeviceData: Your phone's notification token, phone model, app version, time zone and language; the notifications sent to you
privacy.rowDeviceKept: The phone details until you delete your account; the notifications for one year.
privacy.rowDevicePurpose: To send the reminders and alerts you choose, at the right local time and in your language, and to show them in your inbox.
privacy.rowFeedbackData: What you write to us and the type of issue
privacy.rowFeedbackPurpose: To answer you and to resolve problems and privacy requests.
privacy.rowGoogleData: Your Google account ID, name and email address
privacy.rowGooglePurpose: To sign you in with Google. We never see your Google password, contacts, files or mail.
privacy.rowLocationData: Your phone or browser location, only when you tap My Location
privacy.rowLocationKept: Not saved. It is used for that one calculation; we keep no location history and never read your location in the background.
privacy.rowLocationPurpose: To calculate the Panchangam (sunrise, tithi, Rahu Kalam and other timings) for where you are.
privacy.rowPasswordPurpose: To check that it is you when you sign in. It is stored only as a one-way hash, so nobody, including us, can read it.
privacy.rowPracticeData: Japa counts, malas, streaks, favourites, puja progress, calendar entries
privacy.rowPracticePurpose: To keep your sadhana and favourites safe and the same on every device.
privacy.rowSecurityData: IP address, browser or device type, sign-in and sign-out times, errors
privacy.rowSecurityPurpose: To protect your account, detect misuse and investigate security incidents, as Indian law requires.
privacy.rowUsageData: Which screens you open and when
privacy.rowUsagePurpose: To learn which features help seekers. Off unless you switch it on in My Profile, and never collected for guests.
privacy.s10Body: Each version of this notice has a number and a date (above). When we change what we collect or why, we raise the version and ask you to read and accept it again in the app before you continue.
privacy.s11Body: You can read this notice in English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil or Kannada by changing the app language. If the versions differ, the English text prevails.
privacy.s12Body: For any question, request or complaint about your personal data, contact our Grievance Officer:
privacy.s1Body: {0} is provided by {1}. We decide why and how your personal data is used, which makes us the Data Fiduciary under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This notice tells you what we collect, why, how long we keep it, and how to use your rights.
privacy.s1Scope: It covers the Android and iOS apps and the website. We collect only what the features you use need, and we never sell your personal data.
privacy.s2Guest: If you continue as a guest, we collect no account details; only the security logs above are kept.
privacy.s3Body: We use your personal data because you agree to this notice when you create your account. Optional uses, such as usage statistics, are asked for separately and stay off until you switch them on.
privacy.s3Title: Your Consent and How to Withdraw It
privacy.s3Withdraw1: Switch an optional use off at any time in My Profile, under Privacy and Your Data. It stops at once.
privacy.s3Withdraw2: Withdraw all consent by deleting your account in My Profile. It takes one step, just as agreeing did.
privacy.s3Withdraw3: Withdrawing does not affect what was done lawfully before, and every consent you give or withdraw is recorded so you can see it in your data download.
privacy.s5Body: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal data. Only these service providers process it for us, under contract and only to run the app:
privacy.s5Law: We disclose personal data to a government agency only when Indian law requires it.
privacy.s6Body: The app shows no advertisements and contains no advertising or tracking software. If that ever changes, we will update this notice and ask for your consent first. We will never track or target advertising at anyone under 18.
privacy.s8Duty: In return, the law asks you to give true details and not to file false or frivolous complaints.
privacy.s9Body: Accounts are only for people aged 18 or older, and you confirm your age when you sign up. Under Indian law a child is anyone under 18. We do not knowingly process a child's personal data; if we learn that an account belongs to a child, we delete it. Please tell us if you believe this has happened.
privacy.saveFailed: Your choice could not be saved. Please try again.
privacy.sec1: All traffic between the app and our servers is encrypted in transit (HTTPS).
privacy.sec2: Passwords are stored only as one-way hashes. On the phone, your sign-in is kept in the secure storage of Android or iOS.
privacy.sec3: Access inside our team is limited by role, and access to the system is logged.
privacy.sec4: If a personal data breach affects you, we will tell you without delay through the app (a notification and your inbox) and by email where needed, with what happened, its likely effect and what you can do. We will also report it to the Data Protection Board of India and to CERT-In as the law requires.
privacy.usageBody: Lets us record which screens you open, to learn what helps seekers. Optional and off unless you switch it on; switching it off stops it at once.
privacy.usageOn: Usage statistics switched on. Thank you.
